2026_01_CHI_CAR.headline: Chicago’s passing-game depth meets Carolina’s healthier backfield in the opener
2026_01_CHI_CAR.paragraph1: Chicago opens in Charlotte with Caleb Williams in Year 2 under Ben Johnson, while Carolina is trying to build on Bryce Young’s 2025 playoff step forward. Bears receiver Rome Odunze is questionable with a calf injury; Carolina ruled edge defender Patrick Jones II out, but Jonathon Brooks is cleared. Chicago can stress the Panthers with Colston Loveland and layered play-action if protection holds, while Carolina needs Young to stay ahead of the chains and exploit any Bears communication issues on the road.
2026_01_CHI_CAR.model_rationale: Chicago’s passing-game versatility gives Carolina multiple coverage problems, but the Panthers can keep the game tight if Young protects the ball and avoids obvious passing downs.
